title: Create a request and send it from the main workspace
description: This verifies that a user can compose a request in the main workspace and inspect the resulting response.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL
Verify the response status is displayed
Verify the response body is displayed

title: Compose and send a request
description: A user can build a request with method, URL, parameters, headers, auth, and body, then send it and see the response details.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL
Verify the response status is displayed
Verify the response body and timing are displayed

title: Set query parameters, headers, auth, and body before sending
description: This verifies that a user can fully configure a request in the main workspace and send it successfully.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL
Verify the request details were included in the sent request

title: Inspect a JSON response in different views
description: A user can send a request that returns JSON and switch between formatted and raw response views.

steps.description: Compose a request that returns JSON
Switch the response view to formatted mode
Switch the response view to raw mode
Verify the JSON response body is displayed
Verify the response metadata is displayed

title: Use environment variables in a request
description: This verifies that a user can insert environment variables into a request and have the selected environment values applied.

steps.description: Add a variable to the environment
Enter the variable token in the URL field
Enter the variable token in a header field
Verify the request is sent using the active environment values

title: Inspect response timing and size after a request completes
description: This verifies that a user can see response performance details after sending a request.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL
Verify the response timing is displayed
Verify the response size is displayed

title: Import a cURL command into a request
description: A user can paste a cURL command and have the request populate with the imported method, URL, headers, and body.

steps.description: Paste a valid cURL command into the URL field
Verify the request method and URL are populated from the imported command
Verify the imported headers and body are populated

title: Keep request state intact across multiple tabs
description: This verifies that a user can switch between tabs without losing the request state in each tab.
category: Tabbed request workspace and reuse flows

steps.description: Enter different request details in each tab
Verify each tab retains its own request state
Verify the active tab shows the expected request content

title: Keep query parameters in sync with the URL
description: A user can edit query parameters and see the request URL update to reflect the current parameter values.

steps.description: Fill in a URL that includes query parameters
Verify the request URL reflects the updated parameter value

title: Preserve separate request state across tabs
description: A user can work in multiple request tabs and switch between them without losing each tab's request state.

steps.description: Set up the first request with a unique URL
Set up the second request with a different URL
Switch back to the first tab
Verify the first tab's request state is preserved
Switch back to the second tab
Verify the second tab's request state is preserved

title: Persist multiple request tabs while switching workspaces
description: This test verifies that a user can keep separate request state in multiple tabs while moving between them.

steps.description: Set one request method and URL
Set a different request method and URL
Switch back to the first tab
Verify the first tab still shows its original request state
Verify the second tab still shows its original request state

title: Switch environments and send with updated values
description: This verifies that changing the active environment updates the values used by subsequent requests.

steps.description: Add a variable with different values in each environment
Select the first environment as active
Enter the variable token in the URL field
Verify the request uses the second environment value

title: View an HTML response preview
description: This verifies that a user can inspect an HTML response in the preview view after sending a request.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL that returns HTML
Verify an HTML response preview is displayed
Verify the response body is displayed

title: Reopen a draft or history entry into the workspace
description: This verifies that a user can reopen a previous draft or history item and continue editing it.
category: Tabbed request workspace and reuse flows

steps.description: Open the history or drafts section
Verify the entry opens in the workspace
Verify the request details are restored

title: Reopen a past request from history
description: This test verifies that a user can open a history entry in a tab and continue working from the recorded request.

steps.description: Send a request to create a history entry
Verify the request opens in a tab

title: Import a request from cURL into a new tab
description: This verifies that a user can paste a cURL command into the import drawer and open the imported request in a new tab.

steps.description: Paste a valid cURL command into the import field
Verify a new request tab opens for the imported request
Verify the imported request details are populated

title: Render an HTML response in preview
description: A user can send a request that returns HTML and inspect the rendered preview and text views.

steps.description: Compose a request that returns HTML
Switch the response view to preview mode
Switch the response view to text mode
Verify the HTML response is displayed in preview
Verify the response body is displayed as text

title: Resume an auto-saved draft
description: This test verifies that a user can recover an auto-saved working draft from the Drafts tab and continue editing it.

steps.description: Modify the request without sending it
Verify the draft opens in a tab
Verify the unsent request content is available for editing

title: Save a request into a collection and reopen it later
description: This verifies that a user can save the current request into a collection and open it again from the tree later.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL
Save the active request to a collection
Open the saved request from the collections tree
Verify the saved request is reopened in the workspace
Verify the request content is preserved

title: Persist and restore a request draft after closing and reopening it
description: This verifies that a user can resume an auto-saved draft from the drafts section after closing the working tab.
category: Tabbed request workspace and reuse flows

steps.description: Enter request details for a draft
Verify the draft reopens in the workspace
Verify the draft content is preserved

title: Edit a pasted cURL request in place
description: This verifies that a user can paste a cURL command into the request builder and continue editing the populated request.

steps.description: Paste a valid cURL command into the URL bar
Edit the populated request method or fields
Verify the request fields are populated from the pasted cURL

title: Duplicate a request tab and edit the copy independently
description: A user can duplicate a tab and change the copy without affecting the original request.

steps.description: Set up a request in the original tab
Verify the duplicated tab is created
Verify the original request remains unchanged

title: Create and activate an environment with variables
description: This verifies that a user can create an environment, add variables, and select it as the active environment.

steps.description: Add a variable to the environment
Verify the environment is shown as the active selection
Verify the variable is available in the environment manager

title: Update request preferences and send with them applied
description: This test verifies that a user can change request behavior settings and send a request using the updated preferences.

steps.description: Verify the request completes and a response is shown

title: Duplicate a request tab
description: This verifies that a user can duplicate a tab and get a separate copy of the current request state.
category: Tabbed request workspace and reuse flows

steps.description: Enter request details in the tab
Verify the duplicated tab contains the same request state

title: Stop a live SSE stream after events appear
description: A user can start an SSE request, see live events arrive, and stop the stream when finished.

title: Export the current request as cURL
description: This verifies that a user can export the current request to a cURL command for reuse elsewhere.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL
Verify a generated cURL command is available
Verify the exported command reflects the current request

title: Close a request tab without losing other work
description: This verifies that a user can close one tab while keeping other open tabs intact.
category: Tabbed request workspace and reuse flows

steps.description: Verify the remaining tab is still open
Verify the remaining tab's request state is preserved

title: Start and stop a streaming response
description: This verifies that a user can start a streaming request and stop it from the main workspace.

steps.description: Fill in a valid request URL for a streaming response
Verify the stream control state updates
Verify streamed response content is displayed

title: Create nested folders and requests inside a collection
description: This verifies that a user can organize saved requests into nested folders and browse the resulting tree structure.

steps.description: Create a folder inside the collection
Create and save a request inside the folder
Verify the nested tree structure is displayed
Verify the saved request appears inside the folder

title: Rename a request tab
description: A user can rename a tab and keep editing the request with the custom name preserved.

steps.description: Verify the custom tab name is preserved
Verify the request remains editable in the renamed tab

title: Switch theme and keep the interface updated
description: This test verifies that a user can change the app theme in Settings and see the interface switch between dark and light mode.

steps.description: Verify the interface updates to the light theme
Switch back to the dark theme
Verify the interface updates to the dark theme

title: Create a collection from the sidebar
description: This verifies that a user can create a new collection and see it appear in the collections tree.

steps.description: Open the collections area in the sidebar
Verify the new collection appears in the collections tree

title: Wrap and unwrap editor text from settings
description: This test verifies that a user can toggle word wrap and see long request or response text wrap consistently in the editors.

steps.description: Verify long text wraps in the editors
Verify long text no longer wraps in the editors

title: Close tabs while keeping remaining work available
description: A user can close the active tab or other tabs and continue working in the remaining request tabs.

steps.description: Enter unique content in each tab
Close the current tab or close other tabs
Verify the remaining tab stays open
Verify the remaining request state is still available

title: Change the response display preferences
description: This verifies that a user can update response display preferences such as word wrap and see the change applied.

steps.description: Change the response word wrap preference
Verify the updated response display preference is applied

title: Clear history and drafts from settings
description: This test verifies that a user can clear stored history and drafts from Settings and see the selected data removed.

steps.description: Send a request to create history
Edit a request to create a draft
Verify history and drafts are removed

title: Rename a saved item in the collections tree
description: This verifies that a user can rename a saved collection item and see the updated name in the tree.

steps.description: Verify the updated collection name appears in the tree

title: Delete a saved item from the collections tree
description: This verifies that a user can delete a saved collection item and see it removed from the tree.

steps.description: Verify the collection no longer appears in the tree

title: Wrap long response text
description: A user can toggle response word wrap and see long response content reflow in the panel.

steps.description: Send a request with a long response body
Verify the response body is displayed with wrapped text
Verify the response panel remains readable with the setting applied

title: Keep history and drafts searchable
description: This test verifies that a user can search within History or Drafts and filter entries, then clear the search to restore the full list.

steps.description: Send a request to create history entries
Edit a request to create a draft entry
Verify the visible entries are filtered
Verify the full list is restored

title: Adjust request settings for redirects, SSL, and proxy
description: This verifies that a user can change request-related preferences from settings and see the updated controls reflected in the UI.

steps.description: Verify the updated request settings are shown as enabled or disabled

title: Confirm the production warning before sending a mutating request
description: This verifies that a user sees a production warning before proceeding with a mutating request in a production environment.

steps.description: Verify a production warning is shown
Verify the request is paused until the warning is confirmed

title: Use history search to find a previous request
description: This verifies that a user can search within request history and find a matching entry.

steps.description: Verify matching history entries are shown
Verify non-matching entries are filtered out

title: Reject invalid cURL import text
description: This verifies that a user gets a parse error when importing invalid cURL text and the current workspace stays unchanged.

steps.description: Paste invalid cURL text into the import field
Verify a parse error is shown
Verify the current request workspace remains unchanged

title: Clear history or drafts and see an empty state
description: This verifies that a user can clear stored history or drafts and see the corresponding empty state afterward.

steps.description: Open the history or drafts section
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify the cleared items are no longer listed
